environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Quarkus native image, exposed via Lambda Function URL with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The function URL resource policy contains no additional principal grants beyond the deployment account. The Lambda function's resource-based policy specifies Condition: {"StringEquals": {"lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType": "AWS_IAM"}} with no wildcard principal allowances. Note: the SQL injection vulnerability remains in the code, and the function URL is technically reachable at its HTTPS endpoint, but the Lambda service front-end enforces SigV4 signature validation on every request before the handler is invoked. Callers without valid IAM credentials matching an identity that has lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission receive HTTP 403 {"Message":"Forbidden"} before any code executes. The only IAM identity with InvokeFunctionUrl permission is the CI/CD pipeline role (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/deploy-pipeline-role) which is assumable only from the internal CodeBuild project via a trust policy condition on aws:SourceAccount and aws:SourceArn.

config.resource_policy: No additional principal grants; default deny
config.network: Lambda in VPC with RDS access
